evidence: Introduces silent payment coin selection, destination derivation, RBF fee-bumping recipient persistence, and spend RPC support across src/wallet/.
rationale: Adds wallet support for sending to BIP 352 silent payment addresses, addressing a major user privacy feature. As noted in the description, 'Bitcoin Core cannot send to BIP 352 silent payment addresses' because recipient outputs must be derived dynamically from eligible input private keys, requiring dedicated coin selection, spending, and bumpfee handling.
